Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, HiddenContent

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>visible</p><div style="display:none">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>'
    options = ConversionOptions(hidden_content=HiddenContent("Reachable"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
